papers.title: Temporal Attention-Enhanced Mixture-of-Experts Guidance for Multi-Revolution Low-Thrust Rendezvous
papers.summary: Multi-revolution low-thrust rendezvous requires both long-duration orbital transfer and precise terminal control. This paper proposes a temporal attention-enhanced mixture-of-experts guidance law trained by deep reinforcement learning. A far-range expert acts on modified equinoctial elements, a terminal expert acts on the relative state in the target's local frame, and a learned gate blends their thrust commands. The terminal expert encodes its observation history with a Transformer to address partial observability, and the gate uses a separate encoder to account for the resulting history-dependent command. The experts are pretrained separately, the gate is trained with both experts frozen, and the complete guidance law is then fine-tuned end to end. On 600 test missions, it achieves rendezvous in every case at tolerances of 10 m and 1 m/s, reduces mean flight time and delta-v by 50.6% and 44.5% relative to distance-based hard switching, and remains successful without retraining under navigation errors, unmodeled orbital perturbations, eclipse-induced thrust outages, and thrust loss.
papers.title_ja: 時間的アテンション強化型Mixture-of-Expertsによる多周回低推力接近法
papers.summary_ja: 多周回低推力接近問題に対し、深層強化学習で訓練された時間的アテンション強化型Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）誘導法を提案する。遠距離専門家と終端専門家がそれぞれ異なる状態空間で動作し、学習済みゲートが推力指令を混合する。終端専門家はTransformerを用いて観測履歴をエンコードし、部分観測可能性に対応する。600件のテストミッションで全成功を収め、従来の距離ベース切替法比で飛行時間とΔvを大幅に削減しつつ、ナビゲーション誤差や摂動下でも頑健性を示した。

papers.title: STaSBO: LLM-Guided Strategy Planning and Configuration Selection for Bayesian Optimization
papers.summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) enables sample-efficient search for expensive black-box problems, but its performance depends strongly on surrogate-acquisition configurations whose suitability varies across problems and optimization states. We take a significant step toward LLM-driven strategic management of BO with STaSBO, a task-agnostic meta-controller that plans search behavior and jointly selects surrogate-acquisition configurations, while numerical BO retains responsibility for probabilistic modeling and candidate generation. STaSBO comprises two coordinated stages: strategy planning and strategy-guided configuration selection. A structured memory system connects prior plans, configuration selections, and candidate behaviors to optimization states, allowing the controller to revise its trajectory summary and behavioral plans during planning. To navigate the large joint configuration space, the selection stage shortlists configurations using surrogate fit evidence. Prospective BO-action diagnostics then expose the candidate behaviors, supporting final joint selection against the behavioral plans. Across 12 synthetic mathematical and 10 scientific and engineering application tasks, STaSBO achieves the best average rank against 11 baselines: 2.17 and 2.60, compared with 4.08 and 4.10 for the strongest baseline in each suite, respectively.
papers.title_ja: StaSBO: ベイズ最適化におけるLLM主導の戦略計画と設定選択
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ベイズ最適化（BO）のサロゲートモデルと獲得関数の設定をLLMが戦略的に管理するフレームワーク「StaSBO」を提案する。数値計算による確率モデリングは既存のBOに任せつつ、LLMが過去の最適化状態と行動履歴を構造化メモリで参照し、検索戦略を計画・修正する。この戦略に基づき、サロゲートの適合度証拠を用いて候補設定を絞り込み、最終的な設定を共同選択する。合成数学問題および科学・工学応用タスクにおいて、11種のベースラインと比較し、平均順位で最も優れた性能を示した。

papers.title: Staged Semantic Distillation: Preserving Free-Form Semantics in a Low-Compute Non-LLM Surrogate of a Staged LLM Agent
papers.summary: Staged LLM agents make market and social simulators realistic, but one 102-day run of a 200-agent, ten-index market simulator issues 203,100 language-model calls and returns one realization. Conventional low-compute distillation drops their free-form intermediate state. We present staged semantic distillation, a low-compute method that preserves non-structured semantics in a non-LLM student trained from one recorded trace. A frozen encoder maps each teacher output to a 1024-d vector; the student sees typed stage-tagged vectors with stage-specific visibility, is jointly supervised, and trains with scheduled self-history. One TwinMarket trace yields a 13.2M-parameter deterministic student that trains in 1,658 seconds on one 8-GB GPU and runs with zero teacher or decoder calls and no text generation (0.14 ms per decision). Its analysis stays close to the teacher (cosine 0.943), and swapping semantic inputs between agents moves 64.7% of decisions against 12.8% for a matched donor, so the channel is preserved and live. We use the surrogate to study what the transfer carries. It reaches 0.8347 balanced accuracy on the teacher-forced replay and 0.7783 [0.766,0.791] on the deployment decoder; the five-seed gain over a no-semantic retrain is +2.2 [1.21,3.14]. Against the teacher's own re-sampling level, round-one R is 97.1% [95.8,98.4] and 92.3% [89.0,95.4]; R is a diagnostic, not an accuracy. A five-seed content-by-schedule study isolates the gain: scheduled self-history carries it (+2.2 [1.21,3.14]); shuffled and constant content controls reproduce it, while content matters teacher-forced. The design rule: invest in the deployment schedule, let content earn its place at the teacher-forced operating point. A 20-seed, 200,000-decision sweep takes 12 minutes with zero LLM calls, versus three hours for the teacher. The paper is a method-and-case-study contribution on one simulator and trace.
papers.title_ja: 段階的セマンティック蒸留：段階的LLMエージェントの低計算量非LLMサロゲートにおける自由形式セマンティクスの保持

papers.title: Mesoscale Neural Operators: Learning Nonlinear Constitutive Laws from Molecular Dynamics for Scalable Fracture Predictions
papers.summary: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations can capture the nanoscale physics of fracture at the atomistic level, but their computational cost prohibits predictions at the length scales and time scales needed for many applications. Machine learning approaches, on the other hand, have been proposed as heuristic surrogates for material fracture, yet they cannot guarantee the physical consistency of the predicted response. To address this shortcoming, we propose the mesoscale neural operator (MNO): a data-driven nonlocal constitutive model that is learned directly from MD loading and displacement data. After training, it can be used in continuum fracture simulations on much larger domains and grid sizes. The key idea of the MNO is to exploit the built-in characteristic length of a nonlocal model, called the horizon, to travel across scales. Physical consistency across scales is obtained by building two structural ingredients into the MNO: a normalized kernel that renders the strain energy density invariant under horizon rescaling, and a rescaled critical bond stretch that keeps the energy release rate consistent across scales. Through tests on synthetic data, we show that the MNO and its learning workflow indeed discover the nonlocal continuum multiscale model in the form of the nonlocal kernel and the nonlinear constitutive relation. We then apply the framework to coarse-grained MD data and find that in a test problem, the learned model matches the MD strain energy density and critical energy release rate within 3%. It also predicts the peak transmitted forces within 6% in out-of-distribution tension tests. As a further demonstration, the model is applied to a plate with 4000 times the area of the training specimens and containing an initial defect. In this problem, the model reproduces the main features of dynamic brittle fracture, including branch and cascading branch networks.
papers.title_ja: メソスケールニューラルオペレータ：分子動力学から非線形構成則を学習し、スケーラブルな破壊予測を実現する
papers.summary_ja: 分子動力学（MD）シミュレーションの計算コストを削減し、大規模な連続体破壊シミュレーションに適用可能なメソスケールニューラルオペレータ（MNO）を提案する。MDデータから非局所構成則を学習し、ホライズン（特徴的長さ）の再スケーリングに対してエネルギー密度と臨界結合伸長を不変にする構造を設計することで、スケール間の物理的一貫性を保証する。合成データおよび粗粒化MDデータを用いた検証では、MD結果と3%以内の誤差で一致し、4000倍の面積を持つプレートにおける動的脆性破壊の分岐パターンも再現した。

papers.title: Learning Autoregressive Neural Operators on Solver-Defined Physical Constraint Manifolds
papers.summary: Autoregressive neural operators approximate time-dependent PDE solvers by repeatedly composing a learned transition, although the resulting states need not remain feasible under the discrete constraints of the numerical problem. We study this issue for incompressible flow, where each velocity state must satisfy solver-level incompressibility together with prescribed boundary values. We formulate autoregressive operator learning as a map between solver-defined affine feasible sets and introduce PCM-NO, a projected-residual realization of this feasible-transition principle. The neural backbone predicts a candidate state increment, a fixed tangent projection extracts its admissible component, and a metric retraction maps the advanced state to the prescribed feasible set. With exact affine constraint solves, the resulting transition is closed on the feasible set, while an affine identity separates admissible-update parameterization from state-level closure. With approximate solves, tangent-only residuals admit a cumulative upper bound, whereas per-step retraction resets feasibility to the residual achieved by the current solve. Experiments on periodic Navier--Stokes flow and lid-driven cavity flow demonstrate the superiority of PCM-NO in preserving solver-level constraints over long autoregressive rollouts and under parameter, boundary-value, and resolution shifts, while achieving lower rollout errors and better flow-specific diagnostics across both in-distribution and stress settings.
papers.title_ja: ソルバ定義物理制約多様体における自己回帰型ニューラルオペレータの学習
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、時間依存偏微分方程式（PDE）の解を近似する自己回帰型ニューラルオペレータにおいて、数値ソルバの離散制約（特に非圧縮性）を厳密に満たすための手法PCM-NOを提案する。ニューラルバックボーンによる候補状態増分の予測に対し、固定接線射影とメトリック縮退を用いて、許容可能な成分を抽出し指定された実行可能集合へ写像する。このアプローチにより、長期間の自己回帰展開やパラメータ・境界条件・解像度のシフト下でも、ソルバレベルの制約を維持しつつ、ローリングエラーを低減できることを周期ナビエ・ストークス流やリッド駆動キャビティ流のシミュレーションで実証した。

papers.title: Newton-PINet: A fast physics-informed neural network with Newton linearization for meta-learning nonlinear PDEs
papers.summary: Scientific machine learning has opened new avenues for solving parameterized partial differential equations (PDEs), enabling models to learn a family of PDEs and generalize to unseen instances. In this context, data-driven operator learning methods typically require large training datasets, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) suffer from difficult optimization and limited generalization, especially for nonlinear PDEs. We propose Newton-PINet, a physics-informed network enhanced by Newton linearization, offering an effective meta-learning framework for nonlinear PDEs. Newton-PINet (i) employs a physics-informed multilayer network with skip connections, where the output-layer weights are solved by least squares; (ii) adopts a two-stage learning strategy that first leverages gradient-based training to learn robust representations from the available training tasks, and then performs gradient-free fine-tuning on the output layer for fast task-specific generalization; and (iii) incorporates a Newton linearization method to speed up the least-squares iteration for nonlinear PDE problems. On a challenging nonlinear reaction-diffusion benchmark, Newton-PINet achieves up to three orders of magnitude lower relative error than recent neural solvers, while using 16x fewer training tasks and over an order of magnitude less training time (about 5 minutes versus several hours). This work advances the meta-learning of PINNs toward data-efficient, fast, and generalizable physics solvers. The code and datasets are publicly available at: https://github.com/fycAIwj/Newton-PINet.
papers.title_ja: Newton-PINet: ニュートン線形化を用いた非線形偏微分方程式のメタラーニング向け高速物理情報ニューラルネットワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、非線形偏微分方程式（PDE）の解法として、ニュートン線形化を統合した物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）「Newton-PINet」を提案する。出力層の重みを最小二乗法で解くスキップ接続構造と、勾配ベースの事前学習後に勾配なしで微調整する2段階学習戦略を採用し、最適化の困難さと汎化性能の低さを改善する。さらに、ニュートン線形化により非線形PDEにおける最小二乗反復を高速化し、データ効率と計算速度を大幅に向上させた。反応拡散方程式のベンチマークにおいて、既存のニューラルソルバーと比較して相対誤差を3桁低減し、学習タスク数を1/16、学習時間を1/10以上に短縮する成果を示した。

papers.title: Language Models Meet Vibration Testing for LEO Constellation Satellites with Calibrated Response Prediction from Few-show Sweeps
papers.summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly drive engineering analysis end to end, turning textual records into the inputs of numerical programs, but a plausible and wrong value can pass silently into a decision. We propose deterministic validation gates for LLM-driven engineering analysis, a general paradigm in which a typed configuration produced by LLMs is consumed only after it passes deterministic checks on units, physical consistency, verbatim quotes, agreement between independent models, consistency with measurement exports and the applicability of trained models. The gates target hallucinations from two directions, since quote checking catches fabricated content while agreement between models catches errors of omission that quote checking misses. We instantiate the paradigm on sine vibration acceptance testing for low Earth orbit mega-constellation satellites, where DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Qwen-plus read Chinese test records and extract a configuration of 76 fields. Fact-level F1 ranged from 0.98 to 1.0 on five input variants, with all repairs frozen on development inputs and evaluated on held-out inputs. With all gates, 20 of 20 configurations produced notching results bit for bit identical to the gold run, and all 17 real and injected errors in consumed fields were stopped, of which 16 would have run without gates. Retraining the bound model on a dataset built from an LLM configuration reproduced its results within GPU nondeterminism. We also report a negative result of practical value. Direct LLM curve forecasting only matches linear extrapolation, whereas a small physics-structured network reduces the over-notched bandwidth by 86% to 89% at calibrated coverage c = 0.90, which delineates where direct LLM prediction should give way to a trained model.
papers.title_ja: LEO衛星コンステレーションの振動試験における、少数のスウィープからの較正応答予測を用いた言語モデルとの統合
papers.summary_ja: LLMによるエンジニアリング分析におけるハルシネーション対策として、単位・物理的一貫性・引用検証などの決定論的バリデーションゲートを提案する。低軌道衛星の正弦波振動試験記録から設定を抽出し、ゲート通過後にのみ数値計算を実行するパイプラインを構築した。LLM直接予測では線形外挿と同等の精度にとどまる一方、物理構造を持つ小型ニューラルネットワークにより、過剰なノッチ幅を86〜89%削減できることを示した。LLMの出力を盲信せず、検証ゲートとサロゲートモデルを組み合わせることで、信頼性の高い軌道・構造解析を実現する手法を提示している。

papers.title: Unreasonable Confidence from Simulator Misspecification: Directional Robustness on the SPEED+ Sim-to-Real Benchmark
papers.summary: Vision-based navigation systems for orbit must be trained almost entirely on synthetic imagery, because real labelled images of a given spacecraft in flight rarely exist. Benchmarks like SPEED+ are built for that situation: the training set comes from a simulator, and the test sets are real images of a satellite mockup under two kinds of lighting. That simulator approximates how light reflects off mylar and aluminium, and like every scientific simulator it is misspecified. Its error is radiometric, since it misses the specular highlights, hard shadows and sensor saturation common in real images. We probe the resulting synthetic-to-real gap, the central risk for such systems, with a deliberately simple monocular pose estimator. In a 2x2 study of backbone adaptation and photometric augmentation, trained on synthetic images and tested on both real hardware-in-the-loop domains, we find three things. (1) The model does not know it is failing: regions conformally calibrated to 90% on synthetic data cover only 9-15% of rotation errors on sunlamp and 21-38% on lightbox, so a wrong pose carries the confidence of a correct one. (2) Transfer is asymmetric: scaling data and features improved synthetic rotation error from 1.65 to 1.03 rad but moved the harshly lit sunlamp domain by only 0.05 rad, under twice its seed s.d., whereas adapting the backbone's last stage carried 63-83% of its extra synthetic gain to both real domains. (3) Once the backbone adapts, augmentation helps only in the direction it models: our photometric stack improved the diffusely lit lightbox domain from 1.17 to 0.99 rad on every seed but moved sunlamp no more than seed-to-seed variation, while with the backbone frozen it helped sunlamp more. Every post-review experiment was pre-registered, and the code, per-image predictions and pre-registration record are at https://github.com/lokindoo/spacecraft-pose-estimation.
papers.title_ja: シミュレータの誤指定による不合理な自信：SPEED+ Sim-to-Real ベンチマークにおける方向性ロバストネス
papers.summary_ja: 宇宙機の視覚ナビゲーションにおいて、シミュレータと実環境のギャップ（Sim-to-Real gap）がモデルの信頼性評価に与える影響を調査した。合成データで訓練した単眼姿勢推定モデルは、実環境では誤った姿勢に対して過剰に高い信頼度を示す「不合理な自信」の問題を抱えていることが判明した。バックボーンのアダプテーションと光度学的拡張の影響を2x2の設計で分析し、バックボーンのアダプテーションが実環境への転移に最も効果的であることを示した。また、光度学的拡張は拡散光環境では有効だが、強い光環境では効果が限定的であるという非対称な転移特性も明らかにした。

papers.title: Eclipse-minimising sun-synchronous orbits in a mean-Sun rotating frame
papers.summary: A satellite in low Earth orbit normally passes through Earth's shadow on every revolution. A dawn-dusk sun-synchronous orbit largely avoids it: J2 precession keeps the orbit plane facing the Sun all year, but it follows only the Sun's average position, the mean Sun. In reality the Sun wanders up to 23 degrees around this average, enough to push the plane into shadow for part of the year. We introduce MSSI, a coordinate frame that rotates with the mean Sun. In it, a sun-synchronous orbit is a fixed ring and the real Sun traces the analemma, so the yearly eclipse question becomes static geometry. From that picture we derive how much of each orbit is in shadow, the yearly eclipse for every plane orientation, maps of which directions are never, sometimes or always eclipsed, and the margin a mission has. Fixed planes become eclipse-free above about 1400 km, within a window of node offsets that widens with altitude, and the 06:00 and 18:00 lines turn out to be equivalent. The closed form is checked against a full-force-model numerical propagation and against the published eclipse seasons of three flying missions; the model, its code and an interactive 3-D visualizer are published as open source.
papers.title_ja: 平均太陽回転系における日食最小化の太陽同期軌道
papers.summary_ja: 低軌道衛星の太陽同期軌道における年間の日食（シャドウ）問題を、平均太陽に連動する回転座標系（MSSI）を用いて静的な幾何学問題として定式化する手法を提案する。この系では、軌道面が日食にさらされる割合や、日食を完全に回避できる軌道傾斜角・ノードオフセットの範囲を解析的に導出できる。約1400km以上の高度では特定のノードオフセット範囲で日食フリー軌道が存在し、06:00と18:00の線が等価であることも示された。本モデルは完全力モデルによる数値伝播および既存ミッションの観測データと照合され、オープンソースとして公開されている。

papers.title: On Covariance Steering with Nonlinear Measurements
papers.summary: This paper examines two ways nonlinear measurements complicate the statistical predictions during covariance steering. The covariance steering problem optimizes a control policy across a distribution of possible trajectories rather than a single specific trajectory. This approach has attracted growing interest as a way to account for uncertainty in aerospace applications such as trajectory optimization, stationkeeping, and landing. In many of these applications, covariance steering can account for measurement uncertainty through output feedback. Because standard formulations assume linear dynamics and measurements, applications with nonlinear measurements typically use an extended Kalman filter to estimate the state. This paper shows that techniques used to improve filter convergence, such as measurement underweighting, can reduce the accuracy of conventional covariance steering predictions by violating a key assumption. This is addressed with a new convex formulation that relaxes the assumption. This paper also demonstrates that adjusting the control policy during execution can improve agreement between predicted and actual state statistics. A numerical example of angles-only spacecraft rendezvous illustrates the benefits of the proposed method, and discussions are made regarding the implications of this generalized covariance steering formulation.
papers.title_ja: 非線形観測における共分散ステアリングについて
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、非線形観測が共分散ステアリングの統計予測に与える影響を分析し、従来の拡張カルマンフィルタを用いた手法の精度低下問題を指摘する。観測の重み付けなどフィルタ収束を改善する技術が、共分散ステアリングの重要な前提条件を破り予測精度を損なうことを示した。この問題を解決するため、前提条件を緩和した新しい凸最適化定式化を提案する。さらに、実行中の制御ポリシー調整により予測と実際の状態統計の一致を向上させる手法を、角度のみを用いた宇宙機接近の数値例で検証した。

papers.title: Polygraph: Large-Scale Multi-Session Trajectory Optimization using Pose Graphs
papers.summary: Robots, vehicles, and wearable devices often traverse the same environment many times. Each pass produces its own trajectory from onboard visual or visual-inertial odometry. These trajectories are locally accurate but drift over time and live in unrelated coordinate frames. Turning many such independent trajectories into one globally consistent set is the large-scale multi-session trajectory optimization problem. Existing solutions largely work offline. All sessions must be available up front, one session is fixed as the reference frame, and a single fused map is then optimized. This paper presents Polygraph, a multi-session trajectory optimization pipeline that processes sessions online, one keyframe and one spatial cluster at a time, and never builds a 3D map. Keyframes are grouped into local clusters. When a cluster closes, it is matched against every other session through learned image retrieval. Candidate pairs are verified with sparse feature matching, monocular metric depth, and robust pose estimation. A two-tier consensus gate admits a cross-session edge into the shared pose graph only once independent evidence corroborates it. A cheap incremental solve keeps the graph current, and a periodic robust batch solve prunes outliers. We evaluate Polygraph on stereo outdoor driving, HoloLens and iPad indoor traversals, legged indoor locomotion with a Boston Dynamics Spot, and large-scale outdoor vehicle and handheld routes. Against the closest prior work on the same GPU model, using its reported timings, Polygraph runs faster, commits fewer loop-closure edges, and matches or improves on accuracy.
papers.title_ja: Polygraph: ポーズグラフを用いた大規模マルチセッション軌道最適化
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、ロボットや車両が複数回にわたって収集した軌道データをオンラインで統合するパイプライン「Polygraph」を提案する。従来のオフライン手法と異なり、3Dマップを構築せず、キーフレームをクラスタリングし、学習ベースの画像検索と頑健な姿勢推定によりセッション間のループクロージャを検出する。2段階のコンセンサスゲートと増分法による低コストなグラフ更新により、リアルタイム処理を実現しつつ、大規模環境での精度と速度を向上させる。ステレオ走行、屋内移動、足歩行ロボットなど多様なシナリオで、既存手法より高速かつ高精度な結果を示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道最適化・決定の高速化と実務応用が関心と一致

papers.title: What to Practice Next? Latent Profile-Guided Task Selection for Skill-Evolving LLM Agents
papers.summary: Task selection shapes the experiences available for skill evolution in LLM agents, yet fixed practice schedules overlook differences in skill requirements and evolving task value. Most existing methods, however, rely on fixed schedules or scalar measures of progress, leaving nonstationary skill demands unaddressed. We propose SPG-Select, a framework for allocating limited practice budget using a multidimensional profile inferred from binary outcomes via MIRT. The framework predicts surrogate progress, defined as the difference between consecutive profile estimates, and prioritizes progress in dimensions with larger estimated proficiency gaps. Our SPG-Select-R policy combines these predictions with uncertainty-based exploration and periodic restarting to accommodate nonstationarity. We evaluate SPG-Select on ALFWorld and WebShop with three skill-evolution backends. In the reported runs, SPG-Select-R achieves higher mean held-out terminal success than uniform sampling in all six backend-benchmark combinations, with gains of 1.49-13.18 percentage points on ALFWorld and 0.93-3.13 points on WebShop. Under a predictable linear surrogate model and boundedness assumptions, we establish a high-probability dynamic pseudo-regret bound for surrogate task allocation in terms of parameter path variation.
papers.title_ja: 次に何を練習すべきか？潜在プロファイル主導によるスキル進化型LLMエージェントのタスク選択
papers.summary_ja: LLMエージェントのスキル進化において、固定された練習スケジュールの限界を克服するため、多面的な能力プロファイルに基づくタスク選択フレームワークSPG-Selectを提案する。多項目理論（MIRT）を用いてバイナリ結果から潜在能力を推定し、能力ギャップが大きい次元の進捗を優先的に選択する。不確実性ベースの探索と定期的なリスタートを組み合わせたSPG-Select-Rは、ALFWorldとWebShopで均一サンプリングを上回る成功率を示した。さらに、予測可能なサロゲートモデルの下で、動的擬似リグレットの確率的上界を理論的に導出している。
papers.relevance_reason: LLMエージェント設計とサロゲートモデル、最適化手法の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: Score-Based Stochastic Closure Modeling via Offline Indirect Learning and Online Data Assimilation
papers.summary: Stochastic closure modeling is an emerging area in reduced-order modeling of large and complex (e.g., multiscale, multi-physics) systems, for which the computationally affordable reduced-order physical descriptions (e.g., digital twins for additive manufacturing, world models for AI agents) in numerical simulations inevitably lead to information losses that cannot be well addressed by classical deterministic closures. However, learning stochastic closures typically requires closure data that are difficult to obtain from measurements or often prohibitively expensive to compute using first-principles simulations. In this work, we develop a stochastic closure modeling framework that builds on score-based diffusion models, leveraging indirect offline training and online data assimilation without requiring the direct data of closures. Numerical experiments on two-dimensional turbulent flows demonstrate that indirect offline learning captures key closure statistics and improves predictions of system state. In addition, combining the learned closure with known physical dynamics leads to better generalization capability across different regimes than purely data-driven models that directly predict system state. Compared to standard data assimilation methods with a Gaussian assumption, the posterior-score assimilation better represents non-Gaussian features of the learned closure, and its combination with state-level data assimilation further improves prediction of the system state. The proposed framework enables stochastic closure modeling in realistic and challenging scenarios of complex dynamical systems in mechanics and engineering problems, where non-Gaussian statistics of model-form uncertainties are non-negligible (e.g., due to the nonlinearities of the system dynamics and/or the observations) and true closure data are not available, for both offline learning and online assimilation.
papers.title_ja: オフライン間接学習とオンラインデータ同化によるスコアベース確率閉鎖モデリング
papers.summary_ja: 複雑な多スケールシステムにおける縮約モデルの確率閉鎖を、スコアベース拡散モデルを用いて構築するフレームワークを提案する。閉鎖データが直接得られない状況でも、オフラインでの間接学習とオンラインでのデータ同化により、非ガウス的な不確実性を効果的に扱える。2次元乱流のシミュレーションにより、純粋なデータ駆動型モデルよりも物理法則と組み合わせることで汎化性能が向上することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 縮約モデル・サロゲートモデルと機械学習手法の融合であり、ユーザーの関心と高度に一致する。

papers.title: Generative AI-Driven Parametric Design Optimization Framework for Vehicle Closure Systems
papers.summary: This study presents a generative AI-driven parametric design optimization framework integrating performance-oriented generation with editable computer-aided design (CAD) and downstream computer-aided engineering (CAE) analysis for industrial vehicle closure systems. The framework is demonstrated on an automotive tailgate assembly with complex geometry, coupled components, and competing performance and feasibility requirements. A production-oriented CATIA model is restructured into a reference-based parametric template with a 13-dimensional design representation. An automated CAD/CAE workflow generates parametric models, performs structural analysis, and constructs a database of mass, maximum displacement, and maximum von Mises stress. Gaussian process regression surrogates predict performance, while diffusion and flow matching models generate design candidates. The design problem minimizes mass and maximum displacement, with stress assessed as an engineering feasibility constraint. Performance-guided generation using surrogate guidance and performance-aware training using a performance-aware loss incorporate engineering objectives, with sensitivity to guidance scale and loss weight evaluated. Generative search is compared with NSGA-II under matched evaluation budgets using a common surrogate model. Selected Pareto-region candidates are reconstructed in CATIA and re-evaluated through native CAE; all verified candidates are successfully regenerated and analyzed. Relative to the baseline, the knee-point design reduces mass by 7.1% and maximum displacement by 29.4%, while extreme verified solutions achieve maximum reductions of 10.3% and 37.3%, respectively. The results demonstrate performance-oriented multi-objective design exploration compatible with editable industrial CAD and native engineering verification.
papers.title_ja: 車両クロージャシステム向け生成AI駆動のパラメトリック設計最適化フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、自動車のテールゲートアセンブリを対象に、生成AIとCAD/CAEワークフローを統合した設計最適化フレームワークを提案する。ガウス過程回帰によるサロゲートモデルで性能を予測し、拡散モデルやフローマッチングモデルを用いて設計候補を生成する。NSGA-IIと比較し、質量と最大変位を低減しつつ強度制約を満たす設計を探索した。最終的に、ベースライン比で質量7.1%、最大変位29.4%の削減を実現し、工業用CADでの再現性と検証可能性を実証した。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと生成AIによる設計最適化の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: Clustering-Based Artificial Tree Ensembles for Random Forest Approximation
papers.summary: Random Forests (RFs) offer strong prediction performance but are difficult to interpret. Most representative trees (MRTs) and artificial representative trees (ARTs) provide surrogate explanations, but a single tree may miss patterns within a forest. We investigate benefits and limitations of clustering-based representative tree ensembles for RF surrogate modeling and assess the contribution of similarity-based clustering relative to random tree partitions. Using linear and nonlinear simulations and regression benchmarks, we evaluate fidelity, prediction accuracy, complexity, and prediction stability against equally sized ensembles of top-ranked MRTs and randomly selected trees. Increasing ensemble size generally improves fidelity, accuracy, and prediction stability. ART ensembles show higher fidelity in simulations and often greater prediction stability for small ensembles. Compared with random tree partitions, similarity-based clustering generally improves ART fidelity in simulations and often on benchmarks. On benchmark datasets, MRT-based ensembles generally achieve higher fidelity and prediction accuracy, whereas ART ensembles have fewer terminal nodes. ART ensembles provide compact surrogates when reduced complexity matters and their fidelity and prediction accuracy meet application requirements. These findings clarify both the trade-offs of representative tree ensembles as RF surrogates and the contribution of similarity-based clustering beyond random clustering.
papers.title_ja: クラスタリングベースの人工木アンサンブルによるランダムフォレスト近似
papers.summary_ja: ランダムフォレストの解釈可能性を高めるためのサロゲートモデルとして、クラスタリングベースの人工木アンサンブル（ART）を提案する。類似度ベースのクラスタリングがランダムな木分割と比較して、シミュレーションおよびベンチマークにおいて忠実度と予測安定性を向上させることを示した。MRTベースのアンサンブルがより高い精度を持つ一方、ARTは末端ノード数が少なくコンパクトなサロゲートとして機能する。本研究は、複雑さの削減が重要な場合にARTが有効なトレードオフを持つことを明確にした。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと機械学習手法の組み合わせに直結

papers.title: Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning for Nonstationary Robot Dynamics
papers.summary: Reasoning about what an action will cause requires internalizing how a system behaves. As conditions seldom stay fixed, this must often happen within a few interactions. Yet systems that look identical in a snapshot can respond differently to the same action, depending on physical conditions the snapshot hides. Context-based models capture this separation by summarizing recent transitions into a latent context, but do not specify how that context should change the equations of motion. Physics-informed neural networks build those equations into the model, but describe only a single system and cannot recognize when it has changed. We present Physics-Informed Causal Reasoning (PICR), which bridges the two. Only a context, re-inferred from recent interactions, is updated; it conditions a fixed physics-informed network that determines the robot's inertia and potential energy, so the robot adapts to new physical conditions from its own experience without retraining or a hand-specified robot model. On a Franka Panda arm in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, PICR predicts motion under changing and unseen payloads, reducing error on the latter by 1.6-3.8x over baselines, and extends to counterfactual queries under alternative torques. Our analysis shows that the context, inferred solely from interaction, encodes payload physical properties, tracks their changes, and governs the arm's response. The gravity and inertia terms induced by the context further demonstrate its physical validity, each agreeing with the simulator at the level of individual Lagrangian components.
papers.title_ja: 非定常ロボット力学における物理情報因果推論
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、物理法則を組み込んだニューラルネットワーク（PINN）と、環境変化を捉えるコンテキストベースモデルを統合した「物理情報因果推論（PICR）」を提案する。固定された物理情報ネットワークを、最近の相互作用から推論される潜在コンテキストで条件付け、再学習なしで非定常な物理条件（例：ペイロード変化）に適応させる。Franka Pandaアームを用いたシミュレーション実験では、未知のペイロード下での運動予測誤差をベースライン比1.6〜3.8倍低減し、重力・慣性項の物理的妥当性も検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットと適応型モデルの融合であり、関心領域に直結

papers.title: Risk-Averse Decision-Focused Learning: Minimizing CVaR of Regret
papers.summary: Many combinatorial optimization (CO) problems involve parameters that are uncertain when the problem must be solved. In such settings, the parameters have to be predicted from correlated contextual information before a solution can be computed. \emph{Decision-focused learning} (DFL) addresses this by training the predictive model to produce predictions that optimize downstream decision quality. Most existing DFL methods are risk-neutral and minimize the expected regret. In high-stakes applications this can lead to undesirable outcomes, because decision-makers must also account for the tail risk of decision quality. Prior risk-sensitive approaches typically model uncertainty explicitly and solve a stochastic or robust optimization problem at inference time, which increases computational complexity. We instead propose a DFL framework that achieves risk-sensitive behavior while retaining point predictions and deterministic optimization at inference time. Starting from the dual representation of the Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) and adding entropy regularization, we derive a smooth surrogate for the CVaR of regret. Its gradient induces an instance-dependent reweighting within each minibatch that emphasizes high-risk outcomes, so the approach can turn existing surrogate-loss DFL methods, including the SPO+ loss, into risk-sensitive variants. When instantiated with SPO+, the resulting objective admits a generalization bound on the CVaR of the true regret. Experiments on knapsack, portfolio, shortest-path, and energy-aware scheduling problems show substantial reductions in tail regret when the uncertain parameters exhibit heterogeneous tail behavior.
papers.title_ja: リスク回避型決定焦点学習：後悔のCVaRの最小化
papers.summary_ja: 不確実性を伴う組合せ最適化問題において、従来の決定焦点学習（DFL）が期待値ベースのリスク中立なアプローチであるのに対し、本論文は尾部リスクを考慮したリスク回避型フレームワークを提案する。条件付きバリューアットリスク（CVaR）の双対表現とエントロピー正則化を用いることで、推論時に確定的な最適化を維持しつつ、高リスクな結果に重みを置く滑らかなサロゲート損失を導出する。SPO+損失と組み合わせることで、真の後悔のCVaRに対する汎化境界を導き、ナップサック問題やポートフォリオ最適化などの実験で、尾部の後悔が大幅に低減することを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: 機械学習と最適化の融合、リスク考慮型手法、実務応用への適合度が高い

papers.title: Where the Error Lives: Separating Lid-Edge and Body-Induced Error in Neural Pressure Prediction for 3D Cavity Flow
papers.summary: Can a pressure surrogate score much better globally without better resolving the pressure around immersed bodies? We test this in a three-dimensional lid-driven cavity with an unregularized lid and centered pressure at native $128^3$ resolution. On 60 cases from 12 unseen geometries, with predictions sealed before the CFD truth existed, adding a body-free, Reynolds-conditioned reference correction to the same frozen $64^3$ surrogate lifted to $128^3$ lowers the mean full-volume relative $L_2$ error from 20.6% to 7.5%. In the post hoc regional analysis, the lid-edge junction occupies 1.5% of the fluid but holds 69% of the truth pressure energy and 95% of the uncorrected surrogate's squared error. Interior error changes by just +0.16% relative, and object-local peak error and recall change little on average. Retrospective ablations locate the learned term's contribution in the interior and near the bodies; rebasing on the reference lowers global error further with little change in cohort-mean near-body metrics. Reference-relative body-response error remains about 25% in the interior near-body band. Grid-refinement, lid-regularization and convergence checks delimit the numerical scope. In this benchmark, a large global gain chiefly reflects correction of a shared boundary field, not better resolution of the body response. We recommend reporting regional truth-energy and model-error shares alongside near-body and reference-relative body-response errors.
papers.title_ja: 誤差はどこにあるか：3Dキャビティ流れにおけるニューラル圧力予測の蓋縁部と物体誘起誤差の分離
papers.summary_ja: 3Dリッド駆動キャビティ流れにおける圧力サロゲートモデルの誤差構造を分析した研究である。未確認幾何学に対する予測において、基準補正を加えることで全領域の相対L2誤差を20.6%から7.5%へ低減させた。しかし後分析の結果、この大幅な改善は主に蓋縁部（境界場）の共有誤差の修正によるものであり、浸没物体近傍の圧力解決精度の向上には寄与していないことが判明した。したがって、サロゲートモデルの評価では、全体的な誤差だけでなく、領域別の真値エネルギー比や物体近傍の相対誤差を併記するべきと提言している。
papers.relevance_reason: 流体サロゲートモデルの誤差分析と評価手法の改善提案であり、高関連。

papers.title: Tight Sequential Confidence Intervals for Online Kernel Regression
papers.summary: We characterize, in the worst case over kernels, the sharp minimax width of online confidence intervals for elements of a reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS). This resolves the open problem posed by Vakili et al. (2021) in its original discrete-time form. A learner observes $y_i=f(x_i)+\epsilon_i$ at adaptively chosen points, with $\|f\|_{\mathcal H_k}\le B$ and i.i.d. $R$-sub-Gaussian noise, and reports the interval $|f(x)-\mu_n(x)|\le\rho_n(\delta)\sigma_n(x)$, where $\mu_n$ and $\sigma_n$ are the posterior mean and standard deviation of a surrogate Gaussian process model with regularization parameter $\lambda$. Writing $\rho_n^*(\delta)$ for the minimax confidence width for a fixed kernel, we show that, for the sum of a linear kernel and a periodic Sobolev kernel, all sufficiently large $n$, and all $\delta\in(0,1/4]$, $\rho_n^*(\delta)\asymp B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n+\log(1/\delta)}$, where $\gamma_n$ is the maximal information gain and grows polynomially in $n$. Building on Lattimore (2023), we construct an adaptive design on a fixed two-dimensional domain for which, under Gaussian noise, the normalized error at a prespecified point is $\Omega(B+(R/\lambda)\sqrt{\gamma_n})$ with constant probability. This rules out the conjectured polylogarithmic width in the worst case over kernels and online designs.
papers.title_ja: オンラインカーネル回帰における緊密な逐次信頼区間
papers.summary_ja: 再生核ヒルベルト空間（RKHS）におけるオンラインカーネル回帰の信頼区間の最小最大幅を、カーネルの最悪ケースに対して特徴付けました。Vakili らが提起した未解決問題を解き、線形カーネルと周期的ソボレフカーネルの和において、信頼区間の幅が情報利得の平方根に比例することを示しました。さらに、2次元領域における適応設計を用いて、ガウスノイズ下で誤差が特定の確率で下界に達することを証明し、カーネルと設計の最悪ケースにおいてポリログ幅が成立しないことを示しました。
papers.relevance_reason: ガウス過程・カーネル回帰の理論的限界と適応設計に関する高度な研究

papers.title: Variance Stable Gaussian Smoothing Estimator for Arbitrary High-order Derivatives
papers.summary: Computing high-order partial derivatives in high dimensions by automatic differentiation can be costly in both computation and memory. Stein's identity offers an alternative through Gaussian smoothing, but the variance of the resulting estimators can diverge as the step size tends to zero, even with antithetic sampling. We propose a variance stabilization technique that extends antithetic sampling from a reflection pair to $n$ equally spaced points on a circle in the complex plane. Under local analyticity, we prove that, when $n$ is at least the derivative order, the bias is of order $O(\sigma^n)$ and the variance remains bounded as the smoothing step size $\sigma$ tends to zero. Numerical experiments support these predictions and demonstrate the effectiveness of the estimator in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for polyharmonic and Cahn--Hilliard equations. The technique mitigates the bias-variance trade-off in smoothing-based derivative estimation and is useful for PINNs solving high-order partial differential equations.
papers.title_ja: 任意の高次微分に対する分散安定ガウス平滑化推定器
papers.summary_ja: 高次元空間での高次偏微分計算において、自動微分の計算コストとメモリ負荷を軽減する手法を提案する。ガウス平滑化を用いた推定器の分散発散問題を解決するため、複素平面上の等間隔点を用いた分散安定化技術を開発した。局所解析性のもとで、平滑化ステップサイズがゼロに近づく際にも分散が有界であることを理論的に証明した。数値実験では、ポリ調和方程式やCahn-Hilliard方程式を解く物理情報ニューラルネット（PINN）において、バイアスと分散のトレードオフを改善し、高次偏微分方程式の求解に有効であることを示した。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNと高次微分計算の効率化は、ユーザーの関心である物理情報ニューラルネットとML手法の交点に位置する。

papers.title: A Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-Head Attention Model: A Surrogate for Parallel DEVS Semiconductor Fab Simulation
papers.summary: Semiconductor factories process many kinds of wafers organized into lots of various sizes and configurations. Different kinds of machines, each with its own operations, process wafers for hours to days, and the wafers undergo many incremental fabrication steps (with re-entry) and flows spanning days to weeks across connected machines. Fast and accurate predictions of throughput ($TH$) and turnaround time ($TA$) dynamics for individual machines and their combinations are essential for factory operations. To use machine learning methods for this purpose, this paper presents a Temporal Convolutional Network with Multi-head Attention (TCNA) architecture. It uses simulated datasets from a benchmark Parallel DEVS (PDEVS) semiconductor fabrication factory model. The factory processes configurable wafer lots with uniform and sinusoidal wafer arrival profiles and may undergo preventive maintenance. The wafer lot size, arrival profile, and factory maintenance policy are used as static covariates. TCNA is applied to a selected set of simulated discrete-event throughput and turnaround time trajectories. The $TH$ and $TA$ time series predicted by TCNA, evaluated with the common $MAPE$, $MSE$, and $R^2$ measures, show comparable or higher accuracy relative to other model architectures, with similar parameter counts and epoch times; the TCNA model size and execution time are similar to those of other architectures such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer. Although time series predictions are less accurate than high-resolution simulations, they can be deployed at a much lower computational cost. The TCNA achieves orders-of-magnitude speedup over PDEVS simulation with an acceptable loss of accuracy, enabling frequent product scheduling, capacity planning, and maintenance planning.
papers.title_ja: マルチヘッドアテンション付き時間畳み込みネットワーク：並列DEVS半導体ファクトリシミュレーションのサロゲートモデル
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、半導体製造プロセスのシミュレーションを高速化するためのサロゲートモデルとして、時間畳み込みネットワーク（TCN）とマルチヘッドアテンションを組み合わせたTCNAアーキテクチャを提案する。並列DEVS（PDEVS）による離散事象シミュレーションで生成されたスループットとターンアラウンドタイムの時系列データを用いて学習し、既存のモデルと比較して同等以上の精度を維持しつつ、計算コストを大幅に削減できることを示す。この手法により、頻繁な生産スケジューリングや設備計画が可能になり、高精度シミュレーションに比べ桁違いの高速化を実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルによるシミュレーション高速化という関心領域に直接該当する

papers.title: A Staggered Discontinuous Galerkin Neural Network Method with a Computable Error Decomposition
papers.summary: We develop a staggered discontinuous Galerkin neural network (SDGNN) method for scalar elliptic problems with a computable error decomposition. The staggered discontinuous Galerkin (SDG) method requires only local continuity of its trial functions and gives a square, inf-sup stable system without stabilization parameters; we carry this structure over to neural networks. Networks defined on the patches of a staggered mesh satisfy the SDG continuity conditions for all values of the network parameters, and the loss is the squared dual norm of the SDG weak residual. We show that the loss is equivalent, with computable constants, to the square of the training error, the distance between the SDG projection of the network and the SDG finite element approximation, so that the full error is bounded by the discretization error, a multiple of the square root of the loss, and the network projection error. The weak residual requires no derivatives of the networks, the boundary and convection terms carry no penalty or stabilization weights, and the scalar trial functions may jump across the midlines of the primal cells. Numerical experiments show that the square root of the loss tracks the error during the training, that prescribed jumps across a square and a circular interface are captured consistently over the initializations, and that the method is more accurate than physics-informed neural networks at the same parameter counts.
papers.title_ja: 計算可能な誤差分解を備えたスタッガード不連続ガラーキン・ニューラルネットワーク法
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、スカラー楕円型問題に対するスタッガード不連続ガラーキン（SDG）構造をニューラルネットワークに適用したSDGNN法を提案する。SDGの局所連続性条件と安定性をネットワークに組み込むことで、安定化パラメータ不要かつ微分計算を伴わない損失関数を設計した。損失関数は訓練誤差と等価であり、離散化誤差とネットワーク射影誤差からなる計算可能な誤差分解が得られる。数値実験では、同パラメータ数において物理情報ニューラルネットワーク（PINN）よりも高精度であり、損失の平方根が誤差を適切に追跡することが示された。
papers.relevance_reason: PINNの改良と誤差解析が、サロゲートモデルの精度向上に直結するため

papers.title: Joint Learning of Control Lyapunov Functions and Controllers via Stable-by-Design Surrogates
papers.summary: Training and verifying neural network-based control Lyapunov functions (CLFs) can be computationally demanding. To address this challenge, we propose a framework that jointly learns a CLF and a stabilizing controller using structured neural networks and a projection-based parameterization. Specifically, we employ Polyak-Lojasiewicz networks (PLNets), which parameterize nonconvex, positive-definite CLF candidates, and construct a stable-by-design surrogate of the closed-loop dynamics that satisfies the Lyapunov decrease condition by construction. The controller combines linear state feedback with a higher-order correction term resembling Sontag's universal formula and is trained to align the resulting closed-loop dynamics with the stable-by-design surrogate. Unlike classical approaches based on Sontag's formula, our framework does not require a known CLF; instead, it learns the CLF and controller simultaneously. We establish local and global stability guarantees for the learned controller and demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach through numerical examples.
papers.title_ja: 安定性保証付きサロゲートを用いた制御リャプノフ関数と制御器の同時学習
papers.summary_ja: ニューラルネットワークベースの制御リャプノフ関数（CLF）の学習と検証が計算コストを要する問題に対し、構造化ニューラルネットワークと射影ベースのパラメータ化を用いたフレームワークを提案する。Polyak-Lojasiewiczネットワーク（PLNet）を用いて非凸なCLF候補を表現し、リャプノフ減少条件を構造的に満たす「安定性保証付き」閉ループダイナミクスのサロゲートを構築する。制御器は線形状態フィードバックとSontagの汎用公式に類似した高次補正項からなり、このサロゲートと閉ループダイナミクスを整合させるように学習される。既知のCLFを必要とせず、CLFと制御器を同時に学習しながら局所・大域安定性の保証を提供し、数値例でその有効性を示している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと物理情報（安定性保証）の組み合わせが関心に合致

papers.title: A physics-constrained emulator for time-discretised landslide runout modelling
papers.summary: Numerical simulations of landslides are commonly used to forecast impact areas. Full physics-based models provide accurate predictions, but their computational expense can preclude their use for large parameter sweeps. To achieve efficient modelling for such cases, we developed a physics-constrained neural network to emulate full landslide runout in a time-discretised manner. This emulator is trained on over 200,000 samples, each consisting of a pair of landslide thicknesses and velocities on a given DEM with a fixed time interval. To constrain the model's physical consistency, we define physics-based loss functions based on mass conservation and the system's kinetic energy loss. The model demonstrates high fidelity across the test dataset, achieving root mean square errors of approximately 0.06 m for thickness and 0.11 m/s for velocity in single-step predictions. In autoregressive rollout, these errors evolved modestly to about 0.21 m and 0.09 m/s after 110 iterations, while greatly improving computational efficiency by more than 50 times.
papers.title_ja: 時間離散化された地すべり流出モデルのための物理制約付きエミュレータ
papers.summary_ja: 地すべりの流出予測において、計算コストの高い物理ベースモデルの代わりに、物理制約付きニューラルネットワークによるエミュレータを開発した。質量保存則や運動エネルギー損失に基づく物理的損失関数を定義し、20万サンプル以上のデータで学習を行った。単一ステップ予測では厚さ約0.06m、速度約0.11m/sの高精度を達成し、自己回帰的な複数ステップ予測でも誤差は限定的に増加した。従来のシミュレーションと比較して50倍以上の計算効率向上を実現し、大規模なパラメータ探索を可能にした。
papers.relevance_reason: 物理情報ニューラルネットとサロゲートモデルの高速化という関心に直結

papers.title: Set-based State Estimation for Unknown Dynamical Systems from Noisy Output Data with Probabilistic Guarantees
papers.summary: We develop a methodology for set-based state estimation from noisy input-output trajectories, without a predefined model structure for the unknown state dynamics or access to training state measurements. We derive a bound on the state set diameter that depends on the sensor map and leverage it as a surrogate to formulate a tractable linear program balancing state set tightness against output trajectory coverage. Combining this certificate with deterministic or probabilistically certified measurement noise sets and leveraging the results from scenario optimization with relaxation, we provide joint a posteriori probabilistic guarantees for state inclusion and state set diameter. Numerical simulations corroborate our developed theoretical guarantees.
papers.title_ja: 確率的保証付きノイズ出力データからの未知動力学系に対する集合ベース状態推定
papers.summary_ja: 事前のモデル構造や状態測定値が不要な条件下で、ノイズを含む入出力データから状態を推定する手法を提案する。センサーマップに基づく状態集合の直径の上限を導出し、これをサロゲートとして線形計画問題に定式化することで、集合の緊密さと出力軌道の被覆をバランスさせる。シナリオ最適化と緩和を用いることで、状態の包含と集合直径に対する事後確率的保証を提供する。数値シミュレーションにより理論的保証の妥当性を検証している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルと確率的保証を用いた状態推定であり、MLと制御の交差点に関心が高い。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models as Emulators for Forecasting Terrestrial Ecosystem Dynamics
papers.summary: Process-based terrestrial biosphere models such as the Ecosystem Demography (ED) model underpin global carbon budgets, but their cost limits global, high-resolution and scenario-rich simulation. Deep emulators such as DeepED reduce that cost but require task-specific architectures and training. Tabular foundation models offer a different route: TabPFN predicts new rows by in-context learning, without being trained on the task. We compare TabPFN-3.5 with two DeepED baselines, $DeepED_{LSTM}$ and $DeepED_{Transformer}$, on CarbonGlobe's overall evaluation, which trains on a uniform 1/16 sample of sites and tests on the other 50,779, predicting the 40-year state of all seven ED outputs. We then test every model, trained on present-day data only, on ED runs forced by SSP1-2.6 and SSP5-8.5 for 2021--2060 in six continental forest regions. With no training, TabPFN-3.5 has the lowest present-day height error of the three models and is within 4% of $DeepED_{LSTM}$ for soil carbon, but is less accurate for AGB, LAI and the carbon fluxes. In 2060, errors are several times larger than at the same sites under present-day forcing, and every model underestimates the biomass that ED gains. Under SSP5-8.5, TabPFN-3.5 is the most accurate model for height, AGB, soil carbon and LAI, with the lowest AGB error in all six regions, although, unlike ED, it predicts no larger biomass gain than under SSP1-2.6. Under SSP1-2.6, no model is best overall.
papers.title_ja: 陸域生態系動態の予測における表形式ファウンデーションモデルのエミュレータとしての活用
papers.summary_ja: プロセスベースの生態系モデル（EDモデル）の計算コストを削減するため、タスク固有の学習を必要としない表形式ファウンデーションモデル（TabPFN-3.5）をエミュレータとして活用する手法を提案する。DeepEDなどの既存の深層学習ベースラインと比較し、現在の状態予測ではTabPFNが樹高誤差で最も優れる一方、地上バイオマスや炭素フラックスでは劣る結果となった。将来シナリオ（SSP）下では、TabPFNは特定の指標で高精度を示すが、バイオマス増加を過小評価する傾向がある。本研究は、事前学習済みモデルによる物理プロセスの高速シミュレーションの可能性と限界を評価している。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデルとファウンデーションモデルの比較であり、高速化手法に関心が高い

papers.title: Detecting Small Space Objects for Space Situational Awareness with Collaborative Edge AI
papers.summary: With the rapid growth of space activities, near-Earth space is becoming increasingly congested, leading to a higher risk of spacecraft collisions and space debris generation. Recent close-proximity encounters and collision incidents necessitate efficient and cost-effective onboard systems for space object detection (SOD) and collision avoidance. While deep learning (DL) enabled Edge AI using low-cost vision sensors on single or multiple satellites has shown promises for SOD, significant challenges remain, including limited datasets, small SOD, and the lack of comprehensive performance assessments. This paper presents a collaborative Edge AI framework for multiview SOD and systematically benchmarks DL models and fusion strategies. Results show that higher image resolution significantly improves small SOD. For multiple views, image-level fusion reduces the combined communication and inference latency by 30.13% and 32.80% on average compared with feature-level and attention-based fusion across the evaluated inter-satellite link (ISL) bandwidth. For larger view sets, feature-level and attention-based fusion achieve better detection accuracy at the cost of analysis in the sensing-communication pipeline, revealing that multiview collaboration introduces minimal latency overhead under ISL constraints when reception capacity is not exceeded. Our work provides valuable design insights for future collaborative satellite network design, supporting the emerging space situational awareness and space traffic management requirements.
papers.title_ja: 協調エッジAIを用いた宇宙状況認識のための微小宇宙物体検出
papers.summary_ja: 本論文は、衛星間リンク（ISL）を介した多視点協調エッジAIフレームワークを提案し、微小宇宙物体の検出性能を体系的にベンチマークする。深層学習モデルと融合戦略の比較により、高解像度画像が微小物体検出に有効であることが示された。また、画像レベル融合が通信と推論のレイテンシを大幅に削減する一方、多数の視点では特徴量レベルやアテンションベース融合が精度面で優位であることが判明した。本研究は、宇宙交通管理を支える協調衛星ネットワーク設計における実用的な設計指針を提供する。
papers.relevance_reason: 宇宙機関連だが、軌道力学やML手法の深掘りよりシステム設計・ベンチマーク中心

papers.title: Towards GPROF V08: A Machine-Learning Framework for Simulating Passive Microwave Observations of Precipitation
papers.summary: Spatially resolved precipitation retrievals based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs) can improve precipitation estimates from passive microwave (PMW) observations and will be used to implement the next operational PMW retrieval algorithm for the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) mission. However, the conventional radiative transfer simulations used to extend the retrieval algorithm to the various sensors of the GPM constellation do not provide the spatial coverage required to train CNN-based retrievals. To address this, we introduce a machine-learning-based simulation framework that enables the training of the CNN-based GPROF-NN 3D retrieval algorithm for the full GPM constellation. At the core of this framework is Satformer, a new neural-network architecture that can translate PMW observations between any pair of GPM sensors. The resulting synthetic observations exhibit lower errors than conventional radiative transfer simulations and lead to more accurate precipitation retrievals when used to train GPROF-NN precipitation retrievals. We further demonstrate the applicability of the framework to new instruments by developing GPROF-NN retrievals for the Microwave Imager aboard the Weather System Follow-on Microwave satellite. While GPROF-NN retrievals based on the new simulation framework achieve lower instantaneous retrieval errors and higher correlations compared to independent reference data than conventional retrievals, residual simulation errors can introduce systematic biases in the resulting retrievals. The proposed simulation framework provides a key component for extending GPROF-NN to the full GPM constellation as part of the upcoming operational GPROF V08 retrieval algorithm. The results demonstrate the potential of machine-learning-based simulations to support spatially resolved precipitation retrievals across heterogeneous satellite constellations.
papers.title_ja: GPROF V08 へ向けて：降水の受動マイクロ波観測をシミュレートするための機械学習フレームワーク
papers.summary_ja: GPMミッションの降水推定アルゴリズム（GPROF-NN）の訓練に必要な、広範な空間解像度を持つ合成観測データを生成する機械学習フレームワークを提案する。従来の放射伝達シミュレーションではCNNの訓練に必要なデータ量や空間カバレッジが不足するため、GPM衛星群間の受動マイクロ波観測を相互変換する新しいニューラルネットワークアーキテクチャ「Satformer」を開発した。このフレームワークを用いた合成データは、従来のシミュレーションよりも誤差が低く、より高精度な降水推定アルゴリズムの訓練を可能にする。さらに、新衛星（WSFWMi）への適用可能性も示し、異種衛星コンステレーション全体での空間分解能の高い降水推定を支える基盤技術として有効性を検証した。
papers.relevance_reason: 深層学習の応用だが、対象が気象観測であり軌道力学やLLM効率化とは無関係

papers.title: Recovery-Guided Model-Based Diffusion for Safety-Critical Legged Locomotion
papers.summary: Safety-critical high-speed legged locomotion requires motion planners to balance safety foresight with online computational efficiency. Although short prediction horizons reduce rollout costs, they provide limited safety foresight, and strict safety constraints severely restrict the feasible trajectory space. We propose a recovery-guided model-based diffusion (MBD) framework for safety-critical legged locomotion. It incorporates a learned terminal recovery critic into short-horizon trajectory optimization. Specifically, the critic approximates the worst-case future clearance margin along rollouts of a designated recovery policy. We introduce a feasibility-guided refinement strategy that combines within-horizon constraints and terminal recoverability at each sampling stage, while retaining feasible elites to mitigate sampling-support loss. Across 50 paired randomized Unitree Go2 obstacle-avoidance trials, our approach achieves zero collisions and 98% strict-clearance success, while requiring substantially less computation than long-horizon MBD baselines. A project page is available at https://zack4417.github.io/rg-mbd/.
papers.title_ja: 安全クリティカルな脚部歩行のための回復ガイド型モデルベース拡散モデル
papers.summary_ja: 安全クリティカルな高速脚部歩行において、予測地平線の短縮と安全性の両立を課題とする。学習されたターミナル回復クリティクを用い、短地平線軌道最適化に将来の最悪ケースのクリアランス余白を評価する。実行可能性ガイド型リファインメント戦略により、制約条件と回復可能性を統合し、計算コストを大幅に削減しつつ高い成功率を実現した。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習・制御手法だが、宇宙機軌道設計との直接関連は薄い

papers.title: Ionospheric bow waves during Starship Flight 14: coupling through vented propellant
papers.summary: Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) observations of Starship Flight 14 show clear bow-shaped waves in detrended total electron content (dTEC), including during motor-off coast. These observations raise a coupling problem because the spacecraft hull is small compared with the thermospheric molecular mean free path. Sustained visible release in flight video motivates the hypothesis that vented, unburned propellant supplies a much larger interaction region capable of producing a fluid response. We model gaseous methane and oxygen using the Stochastic Parallel Rarefied-gas Time-accurate Analyzer (SPARTA) for direct simulation Monte Carlo calculations at a combined release rate of 10 kg s$^{-1}$. The calculated collisional energy transfer extends over a region roughly 10 km across. We use this deposition pattern as a moving source of mass, momentum and total energy in a nonlinear neutral model coupled to a passive plasma response. The model produces a South American dTEC bow with broadly similar morphology and propagation speeds to the observations. Representative South American cuts have simulated root-mean-square (RMS) residuals of about 0.015 total electron content units (TECU), compared with observed values of 0.021--0.032 TECU; the North American response remains substantially weaker than observed. These results support collisional transfer of orbital momentum and energy by vented propellant as an explanation for the coast-phase waves. The release rate remains uncertain, and chemical contributions require further testing.
papers.title_ja: スターシップ14号機飛行中の電離圏ボウ波：排出された推進剤を介した結合
papers.summary_ja: スターシップ14号機飛行中のGNSS観測データから、エンジン停止中のコーストフェーズでも電離圏にボウ波が観測された事象を分析した。船体サイズが熱圏分子の平均自由行程より小さいため、排出された未燃焼推進剤（メタン・酸素）が流体応答を引き起こす仮説を立てた。SPARTAを用いた直接シミュレーションモンテカルロ計算により、約10kmに及ぶ衝突エネルギー伝達領域を特定し、これを中性大気モデルとプラズマ応答モデルに結合させた。シミュレーション結果は観測された南米地域のdTECボウ波の形態や伝播速度と概ね一致し、排出推進剤による軌道運動量・エネルギーの衝突的伝達が波の成因であることを支持した。
papers.relevance_reason: 軌道力学と物理シミュレーションの組み合わせだが、MLやサロゲートモデルは未使用

papers.title: Exploration of Reinforcement Learning in Generative Recommendation Models
papers.summary: Traditional cascaded recommender systems balance accuracy and efficiency over large item spaces, but misaligned stage-wise objectives hinder end-to-end optimization. Generative recommendation unifies these stages in an autoregressive framework, providing a natural interface for reinforcement learning (RL) to optimize the entire generation process. However, directly applying RL often leads to unstable optimization and degraded recommendation quality. We revisit Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and other ratio-based objectives through a unified logit-gradient view. We identify three issues: (i) clipped surrogates create dead-gradient regions, under-utilizing samples; (ii) negative-advantage updates can become effectively unbounded as importance ratios grow, allowing a small subset of negatives to dominate optimization; and (iii) ratio-based control lacks sensitivity to absolute policy confidence, so updates on high-confidence cases may fail to vanish. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose \emph{Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization} (GBPO), a simple objective with stop-gradient normalization that is simultaneously (a) fully gradient-active, (b) sign-symmetrically bounded for both positive and negative updates, and (c) explicitly confidence-weighted under current policy probabilities. This ensures that updates gracefully vanish for $\pi\!\to\!1$ positives and $\pi\!\to\!0$ negatives. Across the evaluated settings, GBPO achieves competitive recommendation performance with more stable training than competing RL methods.
papers.title_ja: 生成型レコメンデーションモデルにおける強化学習の探求
papers.summary_ja: 生成型レコメンデーションシステムにおいて、強化学習（RL）を適用した際の不安定な最適化問題を解決する手法を提案する。既存の比率ベースの目的関数が持つ勾配の死滅や負のアドバンテージによる支配、信頼度への非感応性という3つの問題を特定した。これらを解決するため、勾配を有界にし符号対称性を保つ「Gradient-Bounded Policy Optimization (GBPO)」を設計した。本手法は高確率ケースでの更新を適切に減衰させ、競合するRL手法よりも安定した学習と競争力のある推薦性能を実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: 強化学習手法の改良だが、対象がレコメンデーションであり軌道力学やLLM推論とは直接無関係。

papers.title: When Zero Is Competitive: A Descriptive Pilot of Transformer and Gate-Graph Surrogates on Random-Angle Quantum Circuits
papers.summary: We examine supervised classical prediction of all one-qubit Z and two-qubit ZZ expectation values on noiseless, layered 4-10-qubit RX/RY/RZ-CNOT circuits. In a 63-cell stratified workload with disjoint circuit-template tests, we evaluate one transformer encoder and gate-dependency graph neural networks against literal-zero and training-derived constant predictors. On the Arm K training labels, 44.89% of scalar targets have absolute magnitude below 0.05. The held-out-template zero predictor has equal-instance mean absolute error 0.193399, and none of the evaluated transformer checkpoints or final graph-network endpoints achieves a lower score. A separate product-state positive control achieves MAE 0.007755 versus 0.514811 for zero, but does not explain the failure on the entangled workload. The difference between zero and a training-fitted mean constant under training MSE is only 0.14%, a descriptive point estimate without uncertainty analysis. The transformer's 815,233-parameter source identity is locally verified; detailed packed-input semantics have not been independently audited. These results constitute a descriptive pilot, not a causal explanation, formal equivalence test, or impossibility claim. Comparable circuits can be regenerated from the workload specification, but exact frozen datasets and model-run evidence remain private.
papers.title_ja: ゼロが競争力を持つとき：ランダム角度量子回路におけるTransformerとゲートグラフサロゲートの記述的パイロット研究
papers.summary_ja: ノイズのない4〜10量子ビット回路の期待値予測において、Transformerエンコーダとゲート依存グラフニューラルネットワークを評価した。結果、訓練データ由来の定数予測器やゼロ予測器と同等以上の性能を示すモデルは存在せず、特にエンタングルメントを含むワークロードではサロゲートモデルが劣後した。これは、複雑な量子状態の古典的サロゲート化が容易でないことを示唆する記述的調査である。

papers.title: Explainable Federated Learning via Global-Local Attribution Alignment
papers.summary: Federated learning enables on-device training without centralizing data, yet existing systems still struggle to provide explanations that are both locally faithful and globally consistent under strict privacy and bandwidth constraints. Prior approaches either keep explanations siloed across clients, transmit heavy or sensitive artifacts, or replace expressive task models with interpretable surrogates that sacrifice accuracy. We propose xFedAlign, a model-agnostic framework that decouples task optimization in parameter space from explanation coordination in a compact group space. Each client distills a lightweight surrogate to produce private, per-class top-k attribution artifacts, which are robustly aggregated by the server into a Global Explanation Prior that softly aligns client explanations without constraining task learning. Across image, text, and tabular benchmarks with IID and non-IID partitions, xFedAlign matches FedAvg accuracy while consistently reducing explanation drift and improving deletion and insertion AUC relative to Local-XAI, FedAttr-Agg, and Fed-XAI, with only a few kilobytes of additional communication per round. Privacy and robustness evaluations further demonstrate reduced membership inference advantage and increased resistance to attribution poisoning, enabling consistent and trustworthy explanations in federated learning.
papers.title_ja: グローバル・ローカル帰属整合性による説明可能な連合学習
papers.summary_ja: 連合学習において、プライバシーと帯域幅の制約下でローカルに忠実かつグローバルに整合的な説明を提供する枠組み xFedAlign を提案する。各クライアントは軽量なサロゲートモデルを用いてプライベートな帰属情報を生成し、サーバー側でこれらを統合してグローバルな説明事前分布を構築する。画像・テキスト・表形式データにおけるベンチマークで、FedAvg と同等の精度を維持しつつ、説明のドリフトを低減し、削除・挿入 AUC を向上させることを示した。さらに、メンバーシップ推論攻撃や帰属汚染への耐性も向上し、信頼性の高い説明を実現する。
papers.relevance_reason: サロゲートモデル利用だが、軌道力学やLLM効率化との直接関連は薄い

papers.title: 3D Radiative Transfer Simulations for Characterization of the Optically Thick DART Ejecta Plume
papers.summary: The Hyperion package is a three-dimensional Monte-Carlo radiative transfer approach to modeling dust ejecta. Because it has proven to be a powerful tool for simulating optically thick environments with complicated structure, we are applying the routines to observations of the DART impact on asteroid Dimorphos. Our analysis focuses on the LICIACube LUKE red-filter image acquired 175 s after impact, when the near-surface plume remained dense and not strongly structured. papers.title: Kepler as an accidental heliospheric imager: Thomson-scattered solar-wind structure in four years of background photometry
papers.summary: Kepler recorded several thousand dedicated sky-background pixels per detector output every 29.4 min from 2009 May to 2013 May while staring at a fixed 12-degree field at ecliptic latitude +65 degrees. From this archive we isolate a large-scale layer that measures brightness variations relative to an 8-day running median. This layer contains fluctuations of 0.02-0.1 electrons per second per pixel (about 1e-17 of the mean solar surface brightness) that sweep across the field in a day or less. Four lines of evidence show that these are sunlight Thomson-scattered by solar-wind electrons. (1) The sweeps propagate away from the Sun (84 percent within 45 degrees of the anti-solar direction; 25 percent expected by chance), and their direction follows the Sun through each quarter and across all 16 spacecraft rolls. (2) The field brightness correlates with the near-Earth (OMNI) proton density within a day of zero lag (r = 0.19, p < 1/150), but not with the energetic-proton flux. (3) Time-elongation maps show fronts moving outward at a median 15 degrees per day, as forward models of radially moving density structures predict. (4) The amplitude is about one third of a parameter-free Thomson-scattering prediction and varies by a factor of about 3 over the year, as predicted. Half of the scattered light comes from within 0.4-0.7 AU of the spacecraft. Fronts are strongest in slow wind. Kepler's background pixels thus provide a four-year, high-cadence, out-of-ecliptic record of solar-wind structure near 1 AU.
